question: Do they report results only on English data?
title: Open Event Extraction from Online Text using a Generative Adversarial Network
answer_rationale: The retrieved documents mention datasets including Google (news article) and Twitter (social media), which implies results are reported on non-English data as well, since Twitter data is from social media and not restricted to English. Additionally, the Google dataset is described as a subset of GDELT Event Database, which typically includes multilingual data.
